country.name: French Guiana
country.jurisdictionNotice: Guyane is a French territorial collectivity governed under Article 73 of the French Constitution, not a sovereign state. French national education, privacy and higher-education law applies with overseas adaptations and territorial implementation.
country.languagePolicy: French is the default interface language, not a substitute for a learner's home language. Guyanese Creole, Indigenous, Bushinengue and other community languages have distinct contexts. Language and cultural adaptation require participation by the relevant community; automatic translation is not reviewed localization.

review.policy: No category becomes verified without a named qualified Guyanese/French reviewer, current authoritative sources and review by the responsible national ministry, Académie de Guyane, Collectivité territoriale de Guyane, customary or community authority, institution or program authority.

governanceModel.summary: French national education law and programs apply in Guyane with statutory overseas adaptations. The recteur de région académique Guyane exercises academic and departmental education functions; the Collectivité territoriale and communes retain their lawful responsibilities. Local language, geography and access conditions require Guyane-specific implementation.
governanceModel.nationalAuthority: French Ministry of National Education and Ministry of Higher Education within their respective competences
governanceModel.territorialAuthority: Académie de Guyane, Collectivité territoriale de Guyane and communes within their lawful competences
governanceModel.schoolRule: Preserve UAI, official name, commune, sector, institution type, academy, open or closed status, services, programs, school-year data vintage and review date. A directory entry does not prove every current service or program.
governanceModel.higherEducationRule: Institutional legal status, authorization, national-degree awarding accreditation, the exact diploma list in an arrêté annex, program or professional accreditation, co-accreditation, site, modality and validity period are distinct claims.

authorities.name: Ministère de l'Éducation nationale
authorities.role: national school law, programs, qualifications, official directories and national education data

authorities.name: Académie de Guyane
authorities.role: regional academic administration, school implementation, directories, staffing and statistics in Guyane

authorities.name: Collectivité territoriale de Guyane and communes
authorities.role: territorial responsibilities for education facilities, services and policy within French law

authorities.name: French Ministry of Higher Education and Research
authorities.role: national higher-education regulation and accreditation to award listed national diplomas

authorities.name: Université de Guyane
authorities.role: public higher-education institution within its legal and accredited awarding scope

authorities.name: Commission nationale de l'informatique et des libertés
Grand conseil coutumier des populations amérindiennes et bushinenges and relevant communities
authorities.role: customary representation and community participation within its legal and cultural remit

curriculum.authority: French Ministry of National Education with Académie de Guyane implementation
curriculum.title: French national programs and official texts with Guyane implementation
curriculum.implementationRule: Confirm cycle, level, class, subject, pathway, official arrêté or Bulletin officiel text, version, entry-into-force school year, transitional schedule, Académie de Guyane guidance, institution and local language or community context before mapping a resource.
curriculum.supplementPolicy: National programs, Académie guidance, regional-language programs, local adaptations, vocational frameworks and external resources are different layers. A draft program, future phased entry date or national resource must not be presented as already effective for every class in Guyane.

schoolDirectory.authority: Ministry of National Education and Académie de Guyane
schoolDirectory.primarySourceName: National education directory and official establishment dataset
schoolDirectory.scopeNotice: The national dataset and Académie directories are discovery sources with different coverage and vintages. A UAI or directory entry does not by itself prove current operation of every site, authorization of every program, current service availability or current contact information.

educationStatistics.authority: Académie de Guyane statistical service and French education-data authorities
educationStatistics.scopeNotice: Every figure must display school year or observation date, publication or update date, measure, definition, statistical field, unit of analysis, population, level, sector, commune or territorial coverage, source and filters. Data observed at different rentrée dates must not be silently combined.

higherEducation.recognitionAuthority: French Ministry of Higher Education and competent authorities according to the qualification
higherEducation.accreditationAuthority: French Ministry of Higher Education after the applicable statutory procedure; specialized authorities apply where legally required
higherEducation.authorityNotice: Accreditation of Université de Guyane to award national diplomas applies only to the diplomas listed in the controlling arrêté and annex. Institutional status, accreditation to award a named national diploma, co-accreditation, site, study pathway, professional recognition and program-specific quality decisions are separate claims. Each claim must preserve the NOR or decision, exact diploma, annex, academic years or validity, partners, site and modality.

privacyAndSafeguarding.dataProtectionFramework: EU General Data Protection Regulation and French Loi Informatique et Libertés, as amended
privacyAndSafeguarding.dataProtectionAuthority: Commission nationale de l'informatique et des libertés
privacyAndSafeguarding.scopeNotice: Controller and processor roles, lawful basis, transparency, minimization, security, retention, data-subject rights, children's age and authorization rules, school and local-authority responsibilities, safeguarding, image and biometric use, incident response and transfers require qualified French and Guyane implementation review before real learner participation.

culturalAndLanguageRequirements.rule: French, Guyanese Creole, Indigenous, Bushinengue and other languages must not be treated as interchangeable. A language shown on an Académie map is an institution-specific offer, not universal availability. Language, orthography, culture, territory, curriculum and community governance require review with the relevant community and competent customary representatives.

completionCriteria: A qualified Guyanese/French education reviewer is named.
French national, Académie, Collectivité, commune, customary-community, institution and program responsibilities are correctly assigned.
Every school record preserves UAI, commune, sector, type, status, programs or services, school-year vintage and review date.
Every statistic shows observation date, publication date, definition, statistical field, population, level, sector and territorial coverage.
Curriculum mappings identify official text, cycle, level, class, subject, version, phased effective year and Guyane implementation context.
Every higher-education claim preserves the controlling NOR or decision, exact diploma and annex, academic years or validity, partners, site and modality.
Regional, Indigenous and Bushinengue language requirements are reviewed with the relevant community and competent customary representatives.
EU, French, academic, territorial, child-protection and institutional obligations are reviewed by qualified counsel.
Accessibility, safeguarding, low-bandwidth, offline, incident and authorization procedures are approved by each participating institution.
No authorization, recognition, accreditation, partnership or credential claim exceeds documentary evidence.
